**P1 — Validate retries that return without an entry record**

The request set is derived only from `WRAPPER_ENTER`. If a victim retry has `ROOT_EXIT`/`WRAPPER_RETURN` evidence but its entry record is missing, this loop skips the retry; `runtime_requests_drained` also accepts extra returns, so the case can pass without validating every retry. Build identities from the union of entry and return events, require matching entry/return pairs in the lifecycle and drain checks, and add a return-without-entry counterexample.
